text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Such a transformation is owed entirely to 
your guidance. 
Truly, a masterful display.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
So long as you support one another and 
walk as one— 
her strength will only flourish ever 
brighter.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
A person's devotion, lifting up an 
umamusume, 
unlocks a power beyond measure...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—No matter how many times I behold it, it 
is dazzling.
